# wowsims links (2 November 2026)

The final set of each spec of the second run, with enchants and consumables. The full wowsims test raid buffs and debuffs, a level 63 boss, 2 min. Open a link, then select Simulate. The sim of this commit gives these DPS values: a later wowsims version can give a different DPS.

| Spec | DPS (895cd67f9) | Link |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fury Warrior | 804.8 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/warrior/dps/#) |
| Combat Rogue | 645.6 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/rogue/dps/#) |
| Hunter | 799.6 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/hunter/dps/#) |
| Fire Mage | 824.0 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/mage/dps/#) |
| Demonology Warlock | 845.6 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/warlock/dps/#) |
| Retribution | 874.4 | [Open in wowsims](https://www.wowsims.com/forever/paladin/retribution/#) |

`zzlink_main.go` makes these links (copy to `cmd/zzlink/main.go`). It also decodes each link and runs it again as a check.
